logarithmic-manipulation-shift.alt: Graphs of f(x) = log base 2 of x and h(x) = log base 2 of 4x; h is f moved up 2 units, so (1, 0) becomes (1, 2) and (4, 2) becomes (4, 4).

logarithmic-manipulation-domain.alt: Graph of y = ln of x squared in green, with two branches, one on each side of the y-axis, through (-1, 0) and (1, 0). The graph of y = 2 ln x, drawn as light blue dashes, lies exactly on the right branch and has no left branch.
